svg.title: Architecture of the distributional regression network: ten inputs per cell and year, standardized, a shared network of 32 (and optionally 16) ELU units, three outputs turned into the mean, spread and shift of a censored shifted gamma, a mixture of three seeds, and the products: tercile probabilities, amount, 10–90% range and the full distribution.
svg.text: relative to the cell’s SEAS5 training mean
is relative to the CHIRPS training mean
standardized with the fold’s training samples
Y = max(0, X + δ) × CHIRPS mean
each with its own held-out years
Training, inside every outer fold (nothing from the scored year):
Loss: closed-form CRPS of the censored shifted gamma (Scheuerer & Hamill 2015), area-weighted, equal weight per year, + weight decay.
Adam (learning rate 0.003, up to 2,000 full-batch steps); stop when the held-out years’ CRPS stops improving (20% of the years, per seed).
Architecture (32 or 32–16 units) × weight decay (10⁻⁴ or 10⁻³) chosen by held-out CRPS; trained on every second cell, forecasts for every cell.
